verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a code-first library whose functionality is exposed through documented programmatic surfaces: server-side `auth.api` methods, typed client methods such as `signUp.email`, and documented plugin endpoints and operations (JWT/JWKS endpoints, admin user management, API key management). Community feedback flags real gaps: no OpenAPI spec was found, the raw HTTP API is poorly documented for non-JS clients, and the request-header-based design makes admin scripts and tests awkward. missing for 10: published OpenAPI/HTTP endpoint reference, documentation for non-JS clients, clean headless/scripting usage.
